arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-cap.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c7996a41c22d99f52f25d4c12e793bb3b3a8917d
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
targets=['README_CODEX.md','CODEX_COORDINATION.md','SMOKE_TESTS.md','roles/SUPERVISOR.md','codex/cloud_bridge.py','codex/owner_coordinator_ingress.py','.codex/config.toml']
for name in targets:
 p=Path(name)
 if not p.exists():continue
 lines=p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
 print('FILE',name,'LINES',len(lines),flush=True)
 matches=[(i+1,line.strip()) for i,line in enumerate(lines) if re.search(r'(?i)(telegram|supervisor|codex.cloud|cloud|credential|agent|coordinator|coordenador|ingress|auth|proof|smoke|e2e|notify|webhook|human.gate|status)',line)]
 for i,line in matches[:12]:
  print('LINE',i,re.sub(r'(token|password|secret)[^ ]*','[REDACTED]',line,flags=re.I)[:190],flush=True)
print('WORKFLOWS',','.join(p.name for p in sorted(Path('.github/workflows').glob('*.yml')))[:1800])
print('CODEX_TESTS',','.join(p.name for p in sorted(Path('codex/tests').glob('test_*.py')))[:1800])
PY
if command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1; then codex --version; else echo CODEX_BINARY_ABSENT_ON_REA_HOST; fi
if command -v pm2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("PM2_NAMES_STATUSES",[(x.get("name"),x.get("pm2_env",{}).get("status")) for x in json.load(sys.stdin)])'; else echo PM2_NOT_IN_REA_USER_PATH; fi
echo REA_TARGETED_INSPECTION_COMPLETE
